message.content: Based on the information provided in the conversation, Li Hua did mention having a new friend named Yuriko before the music festival was discussed. In the first source, Li Hua introduces Yuriko to Wolfgang and mentions, "Hey guys! Just wanted to introduce you both since I think you'll hit it off! Yuriko, this is Wolfgang, my best buddy." This indicates that Li Hua had already introduced Yuriko to Wolfgang before the group learned about the local music festival. Therefore, Wolfgang was aware of Yuriko before the music festival was brought up.
